title: Ziyarat of Imam Muhammad Jawad
urduTitle: زیارت امام محمد جواد علیہ السلام
intro: The ziyarat of Imam Muhammad al-Jawad, also known as Imam Taqi, whose resting place is in Kadhimayn.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Muhammad Jawad with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
Ziarat 1 | Ziarat 2 | Ziarat 3 | Ziarat from Baqeyatus Salehat

First Form of Ziyarat

Recitation at the entrance /Izn Dukhool

blocks.english: Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great.

blocks.arabic: لاََ إِِلٰهَ إِِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ اكْبَرُ
blocks.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu wallahu akbaru
blocks.english: There is no god save Allah. And Allah is the Most Great.
All praise be to Allah for guiding [me] to His religion

blocks.arabic: وَٱلتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا دَعَا إِِلَيْهِ مِنْ سَبِيلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: walttawfiqi lima da`a ilayhi min sabilihi
blocks.english: and for leading [me] successfully to His Course to which He has invited (us).
O Allah, You are verily the most Honorable Besought One
and the most Honorable Purposed One.
I thus have come to You, seeking nearness to You
in the name of the son of Your Prophet’s daughter,
Your blessings be upon him and upon his immaculate fathers
and pure sons.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
never frustrate my efforts,
never cut off my hope,
make me illustrious in Your view

blocks.transliteration: fi alddunya wal-akhirati wa min almuqarrabina
blocks.english: in this world as well as the world to come, and make me of those brought near to You.

blocks.text: You may then enter the shrine by preceding your right foot (to the left), saying the following words:

blocks.english: In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
and on the way of Allah
and on the norm of the Messenger of Allah (I proceed),
may Allah bless him and his Household.
O Allah, (please do) forgive me, my parents,
and all the believing men and women.

blocks.text: When you reach the gate of the dome, you may stop there and ask permission of entrance by saying the following words:

blocks.english: O Allah’s Messenger, may I enter?
O Allah’ Prophet, may I enter?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: O Muhammad the son of `Abdullah, may I enter?
O Commander of the Faithful, may I enter?
O Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan, may I enter?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا ابَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْحُسَيْنُ
blocks.english: O Abu-`Abdullah al-Husayn, may I enter?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا ابَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلِيُّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya aba muhammadin `aliyyu bna alhusayni
blocks.english: O Abu-Muhammad `Ali ibn al-Husayn, may I enter?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا ابَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya aba ja`farin muhammadu abna `aliyyin
blocks.english: O Abu-Ja`far Muhammad ibn `Ali, may I enter?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا ابَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ جَعْفَرُ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya aba `abdillahi ja`faru bna muhammadin
blocks.english: O Abu-`Abdullah Ja`far ibn Muhammad, may I enter?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا ابَا ٱلْحَسَنِ مُوسَىٰ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya ya aba alhasani musa bna ja`farin
blocks.english: O my master Abu’l-Hasan Musa ibn Ja`far, may I enter?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا ابَا جَعْفَرٍ
blocks.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya ya aba ja`farin
blocks.english: O my master Abu-Ja`far, may I enter?

blocks.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: O my master Muhammad ibn `Ali, may I enter?

blocks.text: While entering, you may repeat the following statement four times:

blocks.english: Allah is the Most Great.

blocks.text:
About the ziyarah form dedicated to Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (peace be upon him), the three master scholars (Shaykh al-Mufid, al-Shahid, and Muhammad ibn al-Mashhadi) have said the following:
You may direct yourself to the tomb of Abu-Ja`far Muhammad ibn `Ali al-Jawad (peace be upon him). When you stop near the tomb, you may say the following words:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O intimate servant of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s argument.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ ٱلأَرْضِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya nura allahi fi zulumati al-ardi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s light in the darkness of the earth.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.
Peace be upon you and upon your fathers.
Peace be upon you and upon your descendants.
Peace be upon you and upon your loyalists.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
recited the Book as it should be recited,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: strove for Allah as exactly as striving should be,
and endured harm for His sake
until death came upon you.
I have come to you, visiting you,
recognizing your right,
declaring loyalty to your loyalists,
and incurring the animosity of your enemies;
so, (please) intercede for me with Your Lord.

blocks.text: You may then kiss the tomb and put your both cheeks on it. You may then offer the two-unit prayer of ziyarah, after which you may offer any other prayers. You may then prostrate and say the following words:

blocks.english: (Please) have mercy upon him who had misbehaved and committed sins,
but he then submitted and confessed.

blocks.text: You may then place your right cheek on the ground and say the following words:

blocks.english: If I am the worst servant (of You),
then You are the All-excellent Lord.

blocks.text: You may then place your left cheek on the ground and say the following words:

blocks.english: Your servant’s sin has been very flagrant,
then let Your pardon be very excellent.
O All-generous!

blocks.text: you may then return to the position of prostration and repeat the following word one hundred times:

blocks.english: Thanks.

blocks.text:
In his book of al-Mazar, Sayyid Ibn Tawus says:
You may stop at the tomb of Imam al-Jawad (peace be upon him), kiss it, and say the following words:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-Ja`far
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
the righteous, pious,
and faithful leader.
Peace be upon you, O pleased and pure.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s intimate servant.
Peace be upon you, O confidentially talked by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s emissary.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s secret.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s brightness.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s brilliance.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Word.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s mercy.
Peace be upon you, O shining light.
Peace be upon you, O rising full moon.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلطَّيِّبُ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O pure who is the descendant of the pure ones.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلطَّاهِرُ مِنَ ٱلْمُطَهَّرِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O immaculate who is the descendant of the the immaculate ones.
Peace be upon you, O greatest sign.
Peace be upon you, O grandest argument.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُ مِنَ ٱلزَّلاَّتِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O purified from slips.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُنَزَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُعْضِلاَتِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O deemed above unforgivable failings.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْعَلِيُّ عَنْ نَقْصِ ٱلأَوْصَافِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O raised high against imperfect traits.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلرَّضِيُّ عِنْدَ ٱلأَشْرَافِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O pleased in the sight of the honorable ones.
Peace be upon you, O pillar of the religion.

blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka waliyyu allahi wa hujjatuhu fi ardihi
blocks.english: I bear witness that you are the intimate servant of Allah,
the argument of Him in His lands,
the side of Allah, the best in the view of Allah,
the store of the knowledge of Allah and the knowledge of the Prophets,

blocks.transliteration: wa ruknu al-imani wa tarjumanu alqur'ani
blocks.english: the cornerstone of faith, and the interpreter of the Qur'an.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْهُدَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna man ittaba`aka `ala alhaqqi walhuda
blocks.english: I also bear witness that whoever follows you has been on the right and true guidance

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَّ مَنْ أَنْكَرَكَ وَنَصَبَ لَكَ ٱلْعَدَاوَةَ
blocks.transliteration: wa anna man ankaraka wa nasaba laka al`adawata
blocks.english: but whoever denies you and incurs your animosity
has been on deviation and perdition.

blocks.arabic: أَبْرَأُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَإِلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
blocks.transliteration: abra'u ila allahi wa ilayka minhum fi alddunya wal-akhirati
blocks.english: I repudiate these in the presence of Allah and you in this world and in the Hereafter.

blocks.arabic: وَٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا بَقِيتُ وَبَقِيَ ٱللَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ
blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
blocks.english: Peace be upon you as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.

blocks.text: Then recite this salawaat (invocation of blessings) upon Imam Mohammed Taqi Jawad (peace be upon him)

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household,
send blessings upon Muhammad the son of `Ali,
the pure, the pious,
the righteous, the faithful,
the refined, the bright,
the guide of the nation,
the inheritor of the Imams,
the hoarder of mercy,
the spring of wisdom,
the leader of blessing,
the match of the Qur'an in obedience,

blocks.transliteration: wa wahidi al-awsiya'i fi al-ikhlasi wal`ibadati
blocks.english: the distinctive among the Successors in sincerity and worship,
Your premier argument,
Your highest example,
Your most excellent Word,
the caller to You,
and the director towards You,
whom You have appointed as signpost for Your servants,
interpreter of Your Book,
expounder of Your commands,
supporter of Your religion,
argument against Your creatures,
radiance through whom darkness is penetrated,
excellent example through whom true guidance is hit,
and intercessor through whom Paradise is won.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا أَخَذَ فِي خُشُوعِهِ لَكَ حَظَّهُ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma wa kama akhadha fi khushu`ihi laka hazzahu
blocks.english: O Allah, just as he took his share of reverence for You
and received completely his portion of fear of You,

blocks.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ أَضْعَافَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ وَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: so (please) bless him with many folds of blessings that You have ever poured down on an intimate servant of You
whose obedience to You has been approved of by You
and whose servitude has been admitted by You.

blocks.transliteration: wa ballighhu minna tahiyyatan wa salaman
blocks.english: Convey to him greetings and salutations from us,

blocks.arabic: وَآتِنَا فِي مُوَالاَتِهِ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَضْلًا وَإِحْسَاناً
blocks.transliteration: wa atina fi muwalatihi min ladunka fadlan wa ihsanan
blocks.english: and give us - from You on account of our loyalty to him - favors, kindness,
forgiveness, and pleasure.
You are verily the Lord of eternal favoring
and nice pardoning.

blocks.text: You may then offer the two-unit prayer of ziyarah and say the supplication, which begins with this statement:

blocks.transliteration: allahumma anta alrrabbu wa ana almarbubu…
blocks.english: O Allah, You are the Sustainer and I am the sustained…

blocks.text:
In Man-la Yadhahrul Faqih, Shaykh al-Saduq has reported the following: When you intend to visit Imam al-Jawad (peace be upon him),
you may bathe yourself and put on two clean (and ceremonially pure) pieces of clothes. You may then say the following words:

blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad the son of `Ali,
the pious, bright,
pleasing, and pleased Imam
and Your argument against all those who are on the earth
and those who are beneath the ground
with such blessings that are plentiful,
ever-increasing, pure, blessed,
continuous, consecutive, and uninterrupted

blocks.arabic: كَأَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
blocks.transliteration: ka'afdali ma sallayta `ala ahadin min awliya'ika
blocks.english: and with the most excellent blessings that You have ever conferred upon any of Your intimate servants.
And peace be upon you, O Allah’s most intimate servant.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s brightness.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s argument.
Peace be upon you, O leader of the believers,
inheritor of the knowledge of the Prophets,
and descendant of the Prophets’ successors.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ ٱلأَرْضِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya nura allahi fi zulumati al-ardi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s light in the darkness of the earth.
I have come to you, visiting you,
recognizing your right,
incurring the animosity of your enemies,
and showing loyalty to your loyalists.
So, (please) intercede for me with your Lord.

blocks.text:
You may then pray to Almighty Allah to grant you your personal needs.

A Fourth Form of Ziyarah from Baqiyatus-Salehaat

blocks.english: Peace be upon the most straight door (to true guidance),
the most upright path,
the Divinely supported knower,
the spring of wisdoms,
the lantern in darkness,
the chief of Arabs and non-Arabs,
the guide to orthodoxy,
and the granted success by means of support and leading to trueness;
my master Abu-Ja`far
Muhammad the son of `Ali the Magnanimous.
I bear witness that you are the intimate servant of Allah;
you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

blocks.arabic: وَجَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi sabili allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: strove in the way of Allah as exactly as strife should be,

blocks.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
blocks.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu
blocks.english: and served Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
So, you lived happily
and passed away as martyr.
Would that I were with you,
then should I achieve a great success.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.text:
You may then kiss the blessed soil (of the tomb) and place your right cheek on it.

You may then offer the two-unit prayer of ziyarah after which you may pray Almighty Allah for any thing you want.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام محمد جواد علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
